name: Beyond the Summer
source:
Boring high school life. On such a day a sudden though to go away somewhere comes to the head of main character. It is how he meets that person. This is a heartwarming youth love story.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
乏味的高中生活。就在这样的日子里，主人公突然产生了去某个远方的念头，也因此遇见了那个人。这是一段温暖人心的青春恋爱故事。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
